description: This Python module provides a class 'DatabaseConnection' that interfaces with the 'jwql' database, supporting both SQL and MAST database types. It includes methods for initializing database connections, querying files for specific instruments, and handling database reflection and querying via SQLAlchemy and astroquery.mast.

classes.name: DatabaseConnection
classes.description: Facilitates connection with the 'jwql' database, supporting SQL and MAST types, and provides methods for querying files related to instruments.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the DatabaseConnection object, setting up either an SQL or MAST database connection based on the provided db_type.

methods.name: init_SQL
methods.description: Sets up an SQLAlchemy session with the 'jwql' database, reflecting tables and preparing for queries.

methods.name: init_MAST
methods.description: Configures the service string for querying the MAST database for a specific instrument.

methods.name: get_files_for_instrument
methods.description: Retrieves file paths and filenames associated with a specified instrument from either SQL or MAST database.
